mechanism: Mebendazole is metabolized by hepatic CYP450 enzymes and may have altered metabolism; fluticasone (particularly inhaled formulations) undergoes first-pass metabolism, and concurrent use could theoretically affect systemic exposure depending on formulation and hepatic function.
action: Monitor clinical response; inhaled fluticasone is preferred over systemic formulations when possible to minimize interaction risk; no dose adjustment typically required for standard therapy durations.
